exact.这一步是墙或者自己的身子，会撞上并停住。: That step is a wall or your own body. You bump and stay.
exact.尾巴会跟着头走。箱子在前面就会被推一格。: The tail follows the head. A crate in front is pushed one cell.
exact.尾巴跟着头。推箱子时，箱子前面必须是空的。: The tail follows the head. The cell in front of a crate must be empty.
exact.撞墙或撞自己不会移动，只加一次撞。: A wall or your own body does not move you. It only adds a bump.
exact.把箱子和坞的位置、你从哪一侧推的写进你自己的 memory。只把这些当作这个 s: Write where the crate and the dock were, and which side you pushed from, into your own memory. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
